payload.title: Newsroom app: Articles list and Markus editor with validation, preview, save, publish
payload.description:
## Goal
Staff can write, validate, preview, save, publish and unpublish Markus articles inside the Shadcn newsroom app (`/newsroom/articles`). Minimal editor, no rich-text: a front-matter YAML field, a Markus body field, live validation with line-numbered errors, a read-only rendered preview, and Save / Publish / Unpublish. Images are `PPY-ad5ca4`.

## Context (verified)
- `/newsroom` is a Next app with the ops shell: `app/newsroom/layout.tsx` wraps pages in `NewsDeskClientProvider` (`components/news-desk-client-provider.tsx`: `useNewsDeskClient()` exposes `shell.phase` in `checkingAccess | signedOut | forbidden | ...`, `shell.auth`); `components/newsroom-ops-shell.tsx` `NewsroomOpsShell({ activeTab, appTitle, backLabel, pageTitle, headerActions, tabCounts, children })`; nav in `lib/newsroom-nav.ts` (`NewsroomNavTabId`, `NEWSROOM_OPS_NAV`, `getNewsroomNavHref`, `newsroomHref()` from `lib/newsroom-base-path.ts`); mobile tab icons map in `newsroom-ops-shell.tsx` (`MOBILE_TAB_ICONS`). Existing sections are routed by `app/newsroom/[section]/page.tsx` and `[...selection]/page.tsx` into `components/news-desk-page.tsx` -> the 18k-line `topic-steering-workspace.tsx` (do NOT add the editor there). A static folder `app/newsroom/articles/` takes precedence over `[section]`.
- The sign-in/forbidden gate used by the workspace renders from `shell.phase` (`topic-steering-workspace.tsx` ~L15424-15454, helper texts L15438-15454); reuse the same component/strings or extract them into `components/newsroom-access-gate.tsx` (small extraction, do not restyle).
- UI kit in `components/ui/`: `badge, button, button-group, card, command, dialog, dropdown-menu, hover-card, input, input-group, scroll-area, select, separator, sheet, spinner, tabs, textarea, tooltip` (no Label/Table: use `<label>` and a div-based list like `newsroom-assignments-view.tsx`).
- Data access from the browser: `generateClient<Schema>()` with `authMode: "userPool"` (see `components/news-desk-taxonomy-client.ts` `USER_POOL_AUTH_MODE` usages, e.g. L1022-1028). Models: `Item` (`listItemsByTypeStatusAndPublishedAt`, `get`), `PublishedItem` (`metadata.sourceContentHash` for the pending-changes badge, `PPY-b3a10e`). Writes go through `lib/content-actions-client.ts` (`PPY-3e5235`: `deriveMarkus`, `saveItemDraft`, `publishItem`, `unpublishItem`).
- Demo mode: `?demo=1` renders newsroom pages with in-memory data and no backend (`lib/newsroom-demo-dashboard.ts`, `lib/newsroom-demo-profile.ts`; cucumber steps `features/step_definitions/layout.steps.js` e.g. "I open the newsroom at {int} by {int}"; `features/newsroom-app-chrome.feature`).
- Plain-text editing only (YAGNI): two monospace `Textarea`s; no CodeMirror/Monaco dependency (none is in `package.json`).

## Exact changes
1. Nav: `lib/newsroom-nav.ts`: add `"articles"` to `NewsroomNavTabId` and `{ id: "articles", label: "Articles", detail: "Drafts & published", href: newsroomHref("articles"), mobilePrimary: true }` after `overview`; `components/newsroom-ops-shell.tsx` `MOBILE_TAB_ICONS.articles = FileTextIcon` (lucide). Check `NEWSROOM_MOBILE_PRIMARY_NAV` still fits 4-5 items.
2. Routes (new): `app/newsroom/articles/page.tsx` (list) and `app/newsroom/articles/[id]/page.tsx` (editor; `id === "new"` creates). Both `export const dynamic = "force-dynamic"`, accept `searchParams.demo`, render `NewsroomOpsShell activeTab="articles"` with client components below.
3. `components/newsroom-articles-view.tsx` (new, client): loads `Item` rows for `article#draft`, `article#published`, `page#draft`, `page#published` (four `listItemsByTypeStatusAndPublishedAt` calls via `lib/newsroom-articles.ts` `loadArticleRows(client)`) and `PublishedItem` rows by lineage; list sorted by `updatedAt` desc; each row: title (fallback slug), slug, section, status `Badge` (`Draft`, `Published`, `Published, unpublished changes`), link to `/newsroom/articles/<id>`; header actions: `New article` button; filter `Tabs` (All / Drafts / Published). Uses the access gate for `signedOut`/`forbidden`.
4. `components/newsroom-article-editor.tsx` (new, client). Layout: left column (edit), right column (preview) at `lg`; `Tabs` Edit/Preview below `lg`. Fields: type `Select` (article, page), section `Input` with `datalist` of existing sections, slug `Input` (auto-suggested from `title` in the YAML via `slugify` until the user edits it; disabled with a tooltip once the item has been published: `slug-locked`), `frontMatterYaml` `Textarea` (rows 8, monospace, label "Front matter (YAML)"), `bodyMarkus` `Textarea` (rows 28, monospace, label "Body (Markus)"). Behavior: (a) debounced (600 ms) `deriveMarkus({ frontMatterYaml, bodyMarkus, includeIr: true })` -> validation list (`code`, `message`, `line` shown as "line N" with a button that moves the textarea caret to that line; front-matter errors point to the YAML field), `Badge` "Valid"/"N errors", and the preview; (b) `Save draft` calls `saveItemDraft` with `expectedContentHash` and updates local state from the response (`conflict` -> a dialog "Someone else saved this article" with "Reload" button); (c) `Publish` (disabled when invalid or dirty-and-unsaved: it saves first, then `publishItem`), shows the resulting `versionNumber`; (d) `Unpublish` behind a `Dialog` confirm; (e) `beforeunload` warning while dirty; (f) read-only `Preview on staging` link when `NEXT_PUBLIC_PAPYRUS_STAGING_URL` is set (`<url>/articles/<slug>.html` for static sites, `<url>/articles/<slug>` for Pretext; the base-URL form is documented in `PPY-39f928`).
5. `components/markus-ir-preview.tsx` (new): renders a `bodyIr` envelope (see `PPY-e169c5` for the shape) with Tailwind classes: `paragraph`, `heading` (levels), `list` (ordered/unordered), `blockquote`, `code`, `thematic_break`, `table`; inline `text/emphasis/strong/strikethrough/code_span/link/soft_break/hard_break` (links `rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank"`); directives: `pull-quote` as a styled blockquote with attribution, every other directive renders its children inside a bordered box titled with the directive name (nothing dropped, same rule as `lib/markus-projection.ts`); sentinel tokens: image token -> bordered placeholder `Image: <src> (<alt>)` (`PPY-ad5ca4` swaps in the real image), `[@key]` token -> `[n]` by first appearance, citation-list token -> numbered `<ol>` from `papyrus.bibliography`. Types come from `lib/markus-ir.ts` (`MarkusDocument`); parse with `parseMarkusDocument` and show a visible error instead of throwing.
6. `lib/newsroom-articles.ts` (new, pure helpers, unit-tested): `articleStatusLabel(item, published)`, `hasPendingChanges(item, published)` (`item.contentHash !== JSON.parse(published.metadata).sourceContentHash`), `suggestSlug(frontMatterYaml)` (YAML `title:` line -> `build.slugify` equivalent), `errorLine(errors)`, `emptyArticle()` (`frontMatterYaml: "title: 
"`, `bodyMarkus: ""`).
7. Demo mode: `lib/newsroom-demo-articles.ts` (three rows: one draft, one published, one published-with-changes) and `lib/content-actions-demo.ts` implementing the same interface as `content-actions-client.ts` in memory (`deriveMarkus` returns `ok:false` with code `markus-validation` and `line` of the first line containing `:::nope`, else `ok:true` with a tiny envelope; `saveItemDraft`, `publishItem`, `unpublishItem` mutate the in-memory rows). The client picks the demo implementation when `?demo=1`.

## Data shapes
`NewsroomArticleRow = { id, type, slug, section, title, status: "draft" | "published", pending: boolean, updatedAt }`. Editor state: `{ id | null, type, section, slug, frontMatterYaml, bodyMarkus, contentHash | null, status, versionNumber, dirty }`. API shapes: `PPY-3e5235`.

## Tests
- TS unit `scripts/test-newsroom-articles.ts` (tsx, npm script `test:newsroom-articles`): the helpers in item 6 including `hasPendingChanges` with and without a published row, `suggestSlug` on `title: "Forty Billion Dollars"` -> `forty-billion-dollars`.
- Gherkin (cucumber, demo mode) `features/newsroom-articles.feature` + `features/step_definitions/articles.steps.js`, tagged `@brand-agnostic` like `features/newsroom-app-chrome.feature`:
  - "The articles list shows draft, published and changed articles with status badges"
  - "A new article with invalid markup shows a line-numbered error and cannot be published" (type `:::nope` in the body; expect the error list and a disabled Publish button)
  - "Saving a valid draft keeps it as a draft" / "Publishing moves it to Published" / "Unpublishing returns it to Draft"
  - "The articles screen fits a 390 px wide viewport" (no horizontal scroll; Edit/Preview tabs visible)
- Run: `npm run dev` then `PAPYRUS_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3001 npx cucumber-js features/newsroom-articles.feature` and `features/newsroom-app-chrome.feature` (still green).
- Sandbox smoke (AWS): signed-in editor creates an article with the real Lambda, saves, publishes, then `poetry run papyrus content list articles` shows it; record screenshots (desktop and 390 px) in the PR.

## Acceptance checks
- `npx tsx scripts/test-newsroom-articles.ts`, `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npm run lint` clean for the new files.
- The cucumber features above pass headless.
- Manual: with a sandbox backend, edit an item created by `papyrus content import-markus` (`PPY-22a3b4`), change one sentence, Publish; `papyrus content export-published --out /tmp/x` shows the change in `articles/<slug>.md`.

## Dependencies
Blocked by `PPY-3e5235` (operations + client), `PPY-b3a10e` (record semantics), `PPY-e169c5` (envelope for the preview). Soft: `PPY-672ea6` (`lib/newsroom-nav.ts` unaffected, `middleware.ts` unrelated). Same-file conflicts: `lib/newsroom-nav.ts`, `newsroom-ops-shell.tsx` (only this ticket in Phase 2), `package.json` scripts.

## Risks
- Two plain textareas are deliberately minimal; a code editor can be added later if authors ask (not now).
- The preview is structural, not the site's real styling; the staging site (`PPY-3e5e9d`/`PPY-f00c89`) is the true preview.
- Concurrent edits are detected by `expectedContentHash`, not merged.
- `Item` list scans use `listItemsByTypeStatusAndPublishedAt` partitions: titles/bodies are fetched with the rows; if a site has thousands of items, add pagination (do not pre-build it).

## Needs Ryan
Nothing.

## Common rules (apply to every Phase 2 ticket)
- Work from a clean worktree of `origin/develop` (`git -C /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus fetch origin && git worktree add ../Papyrus-worktrees/<this-ticket> -b feature/PPY-8ef4ca-<slug> origin/develop`). Never commit to `develop` or `main`; open a PR into `develop`; never merge to `main`. Conventional-commit messages. Update this ticket with branch, PR link and the verification output.
- `AGENTS.md` rules that bind this work: no backward-compatibility shims or fallbacks (clean breaks); backend tooling in Python unless noted; Pretext owns text measurement (do not measure DOM in React); read `AGENTS.local.md` before ANY AWS/Amplify/sandbox command; never run `ampx pipeline-deploy` locally (sandbox only).
- Note on language direction: Ryan's 2026-10-05 correction (epic comment 4174c5) says Papyrus is being ported from Python to TypeScript. Phase 2 follows the approved design in docs/standard-site.md (Python CLI/Lambdas + `papyrus-newsroom`). Keep new Python logic in small pure functions with fixture-driven tests so it can be ported; do not add new Python dependencies beyond those named here.
- Tests: Python unit tests are `unittest` under `procedures/newsroom/tests/` (run: `poetry run python -m unittest procedures.newsroom.tests.<module> -v`); backend Gherkin is `behave` under `features_backend/` with steps in `features_backend/steps/` (run: `poetry run behave features_backend/<file>.feature`); UI Gherkin is cucumber-js + Playwright under `features/` (run against a dev server: `npm run dev` then `PAPYRUS_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3001 npx cucumber-js features/<file>.feature`); TypeScript unit tests are `scripts/test-*.ts` run with `npx tsx` (add an npm script `test:<name>` in package.json).
- Install: `poetry install --extras "newsroom markus"` and `npm ci`. Verify `markus --version` prints 0.5.1 (PyPI `anthus-markus` 0.5.1 emits IR `schema_version: 1`).
